name: TME音乐学堂
examples_zh: 我是零基础的新手，想学编曲，推荐一些适合入门的课程。
每周有4小时学习时间，想用3个月系统学完混音，帮我规划一下。
我已经学完四大件编曲了，接下来应该学什么？
examples_en: I'm a complete beginner and want to learn music arranging. Recommend some beginner-friendly courses.
I have 4 hours per week and want to systematically learn mixing in 3 months. Help me plan.
description_zh: 你的音乐成长规划与辅助学习小助手。帮你规划学习路径、推荐课程、解答疑问，陪伴你在音乐学习的每一个阶段。
description_en: Your music growth planning and learning companion. Maps out learning paths, recommends courses, answers questions, and stays with you at every stage of your music journey.
